details: Visa Direct has launched its USDC stablecoin prefunding service into commercial production with Inyo Global. This integration allows eligible payment companies to access 24/7 funding for international payouts, expanding the use of stablecoins in traditional payment infrastructure and facilitating faster global settlements.
title: Visa Direct moves USDC prefunding into commercial production with Inyo Global.

details: Coinbase is collaborating with Marqeta to enable businesses to offer payment cards funded directly by customers' stablecoin holdings. This partnership aims to allow cardholders to spend their stablecoins at millions of merchants globally, significantly enhancing the utility and adoption of digital assets for everyday transactions.
title: Coinbase to power stablecoin-backed cards for Marqeta customers.

details: Over the past 24 hours, Ethereum's circulating supply grew by 2,955 ETH while only 13.6 ETH were burned. This significant imbalance indicates an inflationary trend for ETH, largely attributed to reduced network fees and a shift of activity to Layer 2 solutions, which has lessened the amount of ETH destroyed through transaction burns.
title: Ethereum's Supply Growth Outpaces Burn Rate, Signaling Inflationary Pressure.

details: Bitcoin experienced a brief $1,000 drop over the weekend before quickly recovering, while various altcoins also saw sharp but fleeting volatility. The broader crypto market cap is slightly down, with further price fluctuations anticipated, particularly as the new trading week begins.
title: Bitcoin and Altcoins Recover from Flash Crash, More Volatility Looms.
